turns.text: Hi. The print was delivered to the old flat. I'd like to change the delivery address on that order now.

The delivery address can only be changed before the order ships, and staff must approve the change. Since you say it was delivered, I can’t file an address change. If you need help with the delivered order, please send the order number and the email used to place it.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: Order SC-5209, email cressida.paunelu@example.com. The new delivery address would be Lindenweg 9, Graz.
